value.stringValue: Fact find data saved successfully. Client profile updated, goals created, assets and liabilities recorded, and AI narrative saved to the meeting summary.

Flow.description: Single orchestration flow called by the Fact Find Agentforce Agent. Receives all extracted fact-find data as inputs and saves to Person Account, InteractionSummary, FinancialGoal, PartyFinancialAsset, PartyFinancialLiability, and FF_Client_Vulnerability__c in one pass.

formulas.name: NormalisedEnvironmental

formulas.name: NormalisedSocial
